entry.title: A conversation during a diaper change
entry.summary: Tell your baby what is happening during a needed change, using gentle touch and ordinary words for their body. Their response can be part of the exchange.
detail: The authors describe diapering as private, respectful care. They name what has happened without calling the baby dirty or making a disgusted face.
They explain the next action and leave room for a response or a small movement. The adult still provides the care the baby needs.
In the home-setup passage, they keep supplies ready and always keep a hand on the baby at a raised changing surface.

references.locator: Privacy, neutral body language, communication and necessary care
Supplies ready and hand-on-baby raised-surface condition

ageContext.bookAge: No fixed age in the diapering discussion.
ageContext.readiness: A needed diaper change; the adult provides necessary private care.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
